intro.zh: 三人带着碎晶回到尚未开门的驿站。修复晶石后，他们将迎来第一批客人。
intro.en: The three return to the unopened waystation with a crystal fragment. After repairing the crystal, they will welcome their first customers.

outro.zh: 第一次营业留下了六枚铜币的盈余。晶石的光稳定下来，更深的裂痕仍等待修复。
outro.en: Their first service leaves a profit of six copper coins. The crystal shines steadily, but its deeper cracks still need repair.
